subject.title: fix(pairing): preserve authorized senders when allowFrom reads fail

question: Should this PR be repaired by resetting it to the narrow pairing-only fix, or should maintainers abandon this dirty branch and use a replacement path?
rationale: The central bug fix is useful, but the protected maintainer-labeled branch is currently conflicting and mixes unrelated automation, dependency, app, and generated changes that this review cannot safely accept as part of the pairing fix.

options.title: Reset to pairing-only
options.body: Keep this PR as the canonical fix only after removing the unrelated 350 non-pairing files and addressing the malformed JSON pre-read gap.

options.title: Use a replacement branch
options.body: Open or adopt a fresh narrow replacement that preserves credit from the source PR and then close this branch after the replacement exists.

options.title: Review broad branch separately
options.body: Treat the current head as a broad maintainer change requiring separate owner, security, automation, app, i18n, and dependency review instead of a pairing bug-fix merge.
